title.en: Contrasting reports on staff and management

text.en: Several clients praise specific adoption coordinators and veterinary assistants for patience, knowledge, and gentle guidance when selecting a feline companion. However, other reviewers express serious disappointment with front-desk staff, noting blunt communication, inflexible adoption decisions, and poor customer service. Perceptions of staff attentiveness remain divided.

title.en: Mixed experiences with communication and billing

text.en: While some pet parents appreciate prompt test result follow-ups, others report stressful communication gaps regarding feline boarding reservations and unexpected diagnostic fees. Reviewers cite late-evening phone calls requesting previously discussed paperwork and unannounced emergency rates prior to closing. Clear written confirmation is advised when booking services.

title.en: Feline care with occasional boarding concerns

text.en: Many cat owners trust the dedicated feline center for veterinary exams, kitten adoptions, and routine vaccinations in a dog-free setting. Nonetheless, a boarding client expressed grave concern over chaotic organization, persistent odors, and confusion regarding cat identity during collection. Most medical patients, however, recover well under clinical supervision.

q.en: Is East Lake Cat Care Center completely dog-free?

a.en: Yes, the facility is exclusively designed for cats, providing quiet medical care and boarding free from canine noise.

q.en: Does the center facilitate kitten adoptions?

a.en: Yes, the center hosts an adoption program helping rescued and spayed kittens find permanent family homes.

q.en: What veterinary services are available on site?

a.en: The facility offers routine wellness checkups, feline vaccinations, blood testing, and specialized feline boarding suites.

q.en: Are emergency feline services handled on site?

a.en: While routine and urgent feline cases are seen, late emergencies may be transferred to the adjacent veterinary hospital.
